qa_pairs.question: How do users submit a job after creating a job script in Open Composer?
qa_pairs.answer: Once a job script is ready, users can click the "Submit" button in Open Composer to send the job to the scheduler. A confirmation message with the job ID will be displayed upon successful submission.

qa_pairs.question: What information can users access when monitoring submitted jobs through Open Composer's History tab?
qa_pairs.answer: In Open Composer's History tab, users can see the status of their submitted jobs (Queued, Running, Completed, Failed). They can also click on the Job ID to view performance statistics in my.SciNet, open the job script editor via 'Application,' open an OOD file browser to the 'Script Location,' or display the submitted job script under 'Script Name.'
